newsitem.title: UK: Korea Electric Power eyes 10-year stg bond-dealers.
newsitem.headline: Korea Electric Power eyes 10-year stg bond-dealers.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Electric Power Corp (Kepco) is eyeing the 10-year sterling sector, syndicate officials said on Thursday.
"The bond is expected to be for around 200 million stg," a syndicate official at a U.S. bank said.
SBC Warburg is tipped as lead manager of the transaction, but declined to comment on the deal.
A Kepco official said an investor presentation would be held in London next week. He said 150 million stg would be raised.
Kepco is rated equally with the sovereign at A1 by Moody's Investors Service and AA- by Standard & Poor's Corp.
